title: Interpreting at the Health Desk
transcript:
At a neighbourhood health centre, interpreter Amir Shah helps visitors understand appointment information. When I interviewed him, he stressed that knowing two languages was only the beginning of the job. People may use familiar words differently when they are worried, and an interpreter has to notice when a message is unclear rather than guess at its meaning.

Amir described a recent conversation about a follow up appointment. A visitor thought the instruction meant returning only if the problem became worse. The receptionist meant that the visitor should come back on the date printed on the card. Amir asked both people to explain the instruction again, which revealed the misunderstanding before the visitor left.

I asked whether he offered his own advice to save time. He said he did not. His role was to help the two people communicate, while medical questions had to be answered by qualified staff. If a conversation moved beyond appointment details, he would contact the appropriate member of the health team.

Amir also showed me the simple picture cards used at the desk. They can help someone identify a department or find a room, but they cannot replace a conversation when information is complicated. The centre now gives interpreters the topic of an appointment in advance, without sharing unnecessary personal details. Amir said this small change allowed him to prepare useful vocabulary and made the appointment less stressful for everyone involved.

questions.prompt: What does Amir consider important besides knowing two languages?
options: Recognising when a message needs clarification.
Giving visitors his own medical opinion.
Learning the private history of every visitor.
questions.answer: Recognising when a message needs clarification.
questions.explanation: 他强调应发现表达不清之处，而不是靠猜测翻译。

questions.prompt: What did the visitor misunderstand about the follow up appointment?
options: Whether returning depended on the problem getting worse.
How much the interpreter would charge.
Which language was printed on the appointment card.
questions.answer: Whether returning depended on the problem getting worse.
questions.explanation: 访客以为只有病情加重才需回来，但工作人员的意思是按卡片日期复诊。

questions.prompt: What does Amir do when medical questions arise?
options: Find the answer in a general dictionary.
Tell the visitor to ask another patient.
Refer the questions to qualified health staff.
Replace the questions with simpler ones.
questions.answer: Refer the questions to qualified health staff.
questions.explanation: 医学问题必须由合格医务人员回答，Amir会联系相应工作人员。

questions.prompt: What recent change helps Amir prepare for appointments?
options: He can now choose every visitor's appointment time.
Picture cards have replaced all spoken information.
He receives complete private records of all visitors.
He is told the appointment topic beforehand.
questions.answer: He is told the appointment topic beforehand.
questions.explanation: 中心会提前告知预约主题，使他能够准备相关词汇，不必获取不必要的个人细节。
